description: Candid mobile-phone photograph (screenshot of a phone image, black bars top and bottom) taken from inside a vehicle, apparently through or past a side mirror. A gray-haired man in sunglasses, black polo shirt and black trousers walks away from the camera across a multi-lane road, seen from behind so his face is not visible. Palm trees, a large white multi-story office building, a stop sign (appearing mirror-reversed), and two Audi SUVs are in the background; setting is consistent with Southern California but not confirmed.
flags: Central subject seen only from behind and could not be identified

description: Screenshot (dark mode) of a verified tweet from Donald J. Trump (@realDonaldTrump) dated July 29, 2018, criticizing the media for revealing internal government deliberations, invoking the phrase Trump Derangement Syndrome and arguing press freedom carries a responsibility to report the news.
text: Donald J. Trump. @realDonaldTrump. When the media - driven insane by their Trump Derangement Syndrome - reveals internal deliberations of our government, it  truly puts the lives of many, not just journalists, at risk! description: Long-exposure weather-webcam photograph from SkunkBayWeather.com, timestamped Jun 10, 2018, 03:56:14 AM, showing a bright vertical streak of light rising through pre-dawn clouds over Puget Sound near Whidbey Island, Washington, with an enlarged inset of the streak. The image circulated widely as an alleged missile launch; investigators and the camera owner later assessed the trail was most likely a helicopter light trail captured in the long exposure, not a missile.
text: SkunkBayWeather.com  Jun 10, 2018  03:56:14 AM. Temp:  47.7°F, Wind: SE  at    4 mph, Gust:  8.0 mph, Pressure:  30.0 in, Rain: 0.20 in
flags: The missile-launch interpretation is unverified and was widely disputed; a helicopter long-exposure light trail is the commonly accepted explanation
Streak object itself cannot be identified from the image alone
